method: Drive swing_hinge from prep_angle to target_angle with sustained ctrl=-1.0, ball moved far away (no ball contact possible), damping=0.02 and armature=0.001 kept from <default>, dt=0.002s, deadline=0.35s. Smallest gear meeting the deadline with zero initial contacts and no joint-limit contact is selected. This tests actuator authority only, not zero-torque/held_pose behavior (see VALIDATION_LOG.md for those, measured separately).
target_angle_note: alignment angle: closest approach of the limb segment to target=(0.50,0,0.52) is 0.243mm at angle=-0.264 rad (fine sweep, step=0.001 rad). hinge-target distance = 0.4973m.

candidates.note: never reaches target within 1.0s once isolated from the earlier initial-penetration contamination (see records/REVIEW_2026-09-16.md)

caveats: This is a candidate engineering value verified for the ENV-001 short-distance smoke task's actuator authority only; it is not a biological force estimate.
Does not by itself establish scripted-controller hit rate or task discrimination -- see VALIDATION_LOG.md baseline comparison for that.
